title: pm-dispatch(batch): a slot is a RUNNING subagent or card thread — waiting PRs occupy none; the round report counts running and un-landed separately; a soft ceiling of 5 accepted Tier H PRs awaiting a human
body:
Fixes #27117
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 pm-dispatch 的并发槽改成可数定义 —— 一槽 = 一个正在运行的子代理或卡线程,报告落地即释放;等人批、在合并队列、等 CI、等裁决的 PR 一律不占槽。轮报固定一行「在跑 N / batch · 待落地 PR M」。新增一条软顶:本席已验收、等人批的 Tier H PR 逾 5 就停派新的 Tier H 卡(S 级与非受管照常),轮报列积压,两周后复测。
- 为什么改:席位把「在飞」读成在飞的卡数,四个 PR 只是在等人就停止派发;旧文本留了这个读法。本 PR 把「在飞」从 batch 行拿掉,给出四个不占槽的等待态,并让两个数字并排出现在每轮报告里,混淆一眼可见。
- 风险与回滚:纯协议文本,四个文件行数不变(319 / 188 / 245 / 96),无脚本、无门禁、无标签;风险是席位把软顶当硬门或把两数写反;回滚 = revert 本 PR 一个 commit。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L60(batch 行,324 B,表行 pin 341);`references/execution-duties.md` L20–21(指向唯一定义 + 新软顶行,付账删掉的是旧 L12 sub-issue 候选行);`references/seat-lifecycle.md` L70(两数行,付账删掉的是旧 L15 坐席默认行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` —— 四个文件各印一行 `headroom 0`,SKILL.md 最宽表行仍印 341;`grep -c 在飞 .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 由 8 变 7(少的那一行就是 batch 行)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S:达档契约复核 PASS 后由席位入队)。

## What changes

Four protocol files, every edit in place; no file gains or loses a line, no prose line exceeds 120 bytes, no re-wrap used as currency. Bytes are `wc -c` without the newline. Base `0d45c0e7`, head `90502cd4`.

| File · line | Before (B) | After (B) | What |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `SKILL.md` L60, the `batch` row | 202 | 324 (table-row pin 341; widest row unchanged at 341) | A countable definition: one slot = one subagent (`Agent`, `create_session`) or card thread running now; the report landing releases it; the four waiting states (等人批 · 在合并队列 · 等 CI · 等裁决) occupy none; `dev、复核、普查皆计,⛔ 只读不豁免` stays; the word 「在飞」 leaves the row; p0 is pointed at the `priority:p0` row (`p0 见 priority:p0 行`), not restated. |
| `references/dispatch-runbook.md` L137 | 80 | 120 | 「卡线程交回即释放槽位,席位当即告知 coordinator;审核期开着不占槽,REWORK 补丁轮再占一槽。」 — the 「或其 PR 合入」 alternative is gone: hand-back releases the slot; the thread stays open through review occupying none; a REWORK patch round occupies one again. |
| `references/execution-duties.md` L21 → L20 | 120 | 118 | 「`batch` 等待不填槽,四态见 SKILL.md 该行;同批独立按文件面不相交判,⛔ 不按包或 check 名。」 — waiting points at the one definition; the 「封顶全部子代理」 half now lives in the `batch` row (`dev、复核、普查皆计`); 「不按包、不按 check 名」 is spelled 「不按包或 check 名」 to fit. |
| `references/execution-duties.md` L21 (new) | — | 120 | 「软顶:本席已验收等人批的 Tier H PR 逾 5 ⇒ 停派 Tier H,S/非受管照常,轮报列积压;两周复测。」 — the maintainer's item 4; a SOFT rule: no gate, no script, no label; its only reader is the round-report line below. |
| `references/execution-duties.md` L12 (deleted, pays the line above) | 86 | — | 「已排队父单的 open sub-issue 自动是候选,`pm:epic` 父单的子树除外。」 — home: the same file L11 (sub-issue inherits the parent's first touch) and L41–42 (a derived sub-issue is dispatched directly, bypassing triage); `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 基本规则 3 「归挂不散落 … sub-issue(自动进派发池)」; the epic exclusion lives in `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉 (`label:pm:epic` 即父子保留全集,域座位不取;其它 PM 候选获取跳过整棵子树). |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` L70 (new) | — | 111 | 「报告恒带一行「在跑 N / batch · 待落地 PR M」:N 只计运行中的槽,M 计四态等待的 PR。」 — placed right after the existing report-content line (old L70, untouched). |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` L15 (deleted, pays the line above) | 120 | — | 「坐席从 `batch` 默认 3 起步;前任口径(串行、N、「不开新卡」)维护者对本会话重述才生效。」 — home: the `batch` row's default column (默认 `3`) and the same file's 收班 line (now L40) 「派发口径失效,简报 ⛔ 不列作继承裁决」, which is the same rule from the outgoing side. |

The p0 clause is untouched: the `priority:p0` row (SKILL.md L119) and execution-duties L24–26 as rewritten by PR #27266 stay byte-identical; the `batch` row only points at that row.

## Tests

No package is touched (`.claude/**` only), so no build closure, no package test or typecheck, no changeset (`skip-changeset` declared at `pr_create`), and no ablation (protocol text, not tested behaviour). The gates are the test; see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- PM mechanism hypothesis 5 (the expected gate list) is partly falsified: `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 20 families for this diff, not 7 — `check:pm-half-states` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` are NOT derived (they are CI's), while 15 further families that read `.claude/**` are (closing-keyword parity, comment-mask corpus, governed queue guard self-test, harness-current self-test, doc-formula-expressions, agent-test-spelling, cross-package-test-inputs, doc-authoring, driver-memory-census, gitlink-declared, nul-bytes, pm-expected-skips, pm-governed-merges, refd-timer-probe, watch-hint-literal). All 20 were run; `check:skill-frame-freshness` is local-only and was run beyond the derivation.
- Hypothesis 3 (replace L70's weakest clause instead of adding a line) was measured and does not fit: the fixed two-number line alone is 41 B, and every spelling that keeps 熔断命中项 and the 48h follow-up count lands at 126–142 B against the 120 B cap; so the line is new and paid as described above.
- Hypothesis 1 held: the row rewrite lands at 324 B under the 341 B pin with the four states as four short nouns.
- Observation, not filed (agent-read protocol text, outside the three filing classes; carrier: none): `execution-duties.md` 并行纪律 ③ 「兄弟卡落地后再合一次」 sits beside AGENTS.md §10 「after the PR is open, merge main only on a GitHub-reported conflict, a main-caused CI red or a queue removal」 and runbook L223–225's four-sentence warning that says the same as AGENTS.md; the two readings differ on whether a sibling landing by itself triggers a merge.
- Observation, not filed (same class, carrier: none): SKILL.md L74 「队列空 + 无在飞 + 无待复核 + 决策箱无新答复 ⇒ 自退」 and L75 「分诊席与车道席常驻」 plus seat-lifecycle 〈停止条件与待命〉 「常设座位队列清空不等于退场」 read against each other; this PR leaves all three alone.
- `origin/main` moved twice during this run (0d45c0e7 → abba2c45 → e9c88f7c); the derivation reports none of the moved paths as an input of this card, and none of the new commits touch the four edited files (checked before `pr_create`).

## Verification
